qualification.education_qualification: Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institutions with at least 50% marks including B.Ed component, Master Degree from recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks including B.Ed, Bachelors/Honors Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks, Qualified in Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) / Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET Paper-II), Competence to teach through English and Hindi Medium
qualification.details: PGT (Mathematics, Economics, Sociology, History, Political Science): Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institutions with at least 50% marks including B.Ed or Master Degree from recognized institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject. TGT (Science, Social Studies, English): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks including B.Ed or Bachelors/Honors Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks or three years integrated B.Ed-M.Ed or 01 year B.Ed (Special Education) from RCI recognized institution with at least 50% marks. For TGT (Science): Must have studied Biology/Life Science/Botany/Zoology as main subject. For TGT (English): Must have studied English as Elective/Main subject in at least three years/06 semesters. Qualified in Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) / Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET Paper-II). Competence to teach through English and Hindi Medium.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Atal Residential School Gonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Guest Faculty Teacher (PGT/TGT) posts is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the school before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for the Guest Faculty Teacher (PGT/TGT) positions at Atal Residential School Gonda. These include various PGT and TGT subject specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates need an Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institutions with at least 50% marks including B.Ed, or a Master Degree from a recognized institution with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty Teacher posts is 50 years as of 01st July 2026. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The salary for PGT teachers is Rs. 35750 per month, and for TGT teachers, it is Rs. 34250 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Educational Qualification, Work Experience, and a Counseling/Interview round. Candidates are advised to prepare well for all stages.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Atal Residential School Gonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Is UPTET/CTET qualification mandatory for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be qualified in Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) or Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET Paper-II) to be eligible for these Guest Faculty Teacher positions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: The official website to download the application form and find more details is gonda.nic.in. Candidates should visit this website for all relevant information and forms.
